The map is under construction.\nPlease wait for the update.
A water source...looks like this used to be a\nspring. You can even tell a river once flowed\nhere.
It's completely dried up!
Now, where's the evil spirit that caused all this?
Huh? I just don't understand!\nSeriously, huh? Why am I all by myself?
Hey, is that the flame evil spirit?
Looks like it. Since they said she knew this area\nwell, I was hoping that she'd know about the\nAncient Eternal Charcoal too.
But honestly, she doesn't seem very smart.
What you lookin' at, huh? You got a problem with\nme, huh? You're ruining my mood, you know?
People are having a hard time because you're here.\nSo why don't you do everyone a favor and go back\nto where you came from~?
Back to where I came from? Huh? You do realize\nI'm by myself, right? Are you making fun of me for\nbeing a loner?
Wait, what?! What's even happening right now?!\nThis is unforgivable!!
Whoa, I think she's angry!\nLooks like we have no choice but to fight!
Huh? Seriously? My flames just got blown away?!
Alright! Time for the finishing blow!
Huh? Whatever, I'm just an outcast anyway.\nI've got nowhere to go back to. Do whatever you\nwant with me.
She's saying she doesn't have a home to go back\nto.
Does that mean she's lost~?
I've never heard of an evil spirit getting lost.
Huh? What? I'm already prepared for the worst,\nyou know.
Come with us.
Tell us about this place.
We've got Freedos, and Vasaria is also coming\nlater. Maybe we can ask them to solve your\nproblem~!
In return, tell us about this area.\nYou know, we just got here.
Fair enough. We don't know anything about this\narea, after all. Taking her along might be a good\nidea, just in case.
If we ask Freedos or Vasaria, we might be able to\nfind out where this girl is from~!
So yeah, you're coming with us~!
Huh? Excuse me? I don't get it.
But, it's okay! You can call me Kipina!
Talking her into it was easier than I expected.\nOr maybe she was just lonely?
Ahaha, could be.
Kipina, you kinda stand out.\nYou might scare those weredragons, so you'd better\nstay hidden most of the time.
Huh? Welp, fine.
Hmm~? What's this sound~?
It's the sound of rushing water.
Looks like the spring has started flowing again\nafter Kipina left~.
It'll probably return to normal after some time.\nThat's one problem solved.
Let's go tell those weredragons~!
